quiz.title: JLPT N4 KANJI CHECK
quiz.questionEn: Which English meaning matches the Kanji 「駅」?

subtitles.speaker: Sensei
subtitles.japanese: みなさん、こんばんは！JungGoポッドキャストへようこそ。マリアさん、今朝はちゃんと起きられましたか？
subtitles.romaji: Minasan, konbanwa! JungGo Poddokyasuto e youkoso. Maria-san, kesa wa chanto okiraremashita ka?
subtitles.english: Good evening everyone! Welcome to JungGo Podcast. Maria, did you actually wake up on time this morning?

subtitles.speaker: Maria
subtitles.japanese: あはは、先生！目覚ましを三回止めて、ぎりぎりでした！でも今日はN4の漢字五つ、やる気満々です！
subtitles.romaji: Ahaha, Sensei! Mezamashi o sankai tomete, girigiri deshita! Demo kyou wa N4 no kanji itsutsu, yaruki manman desu!
subtitles.english: Haha, Sensei! I hit snooze three times and barely made it! Still, I'm super pumped for today's 5 N4 Kanji!

subtitles.speaker: Sensei
subtitles.japanese: では一つ目、こちらのボードを見てください！「朝」、Morningです。太陽と月が一緒に入っていますよ。
subtitles.romaji: Dewa hitotsume, kochira no boodo o mite kudasai! "Asa", Morning desu. Taiyou to tsuki ga issho ni haitte imasu yo.
subtitles.english: First up, look here on the board! "Asa" means Morning — both the rising sun and fading moon are inside it.

subtitles.speaker: Maria
subtitles.japanese: わあ、本当だ！私は毎朝コーヒーがないと動けないので、毎朝と朝食はすぐ覚えられそうです！
subtitles.romaji: Waa, hontou da! Watashi wa maiasa koohii ga nai to ugokenai node, maiasa to choushoku wa sugu oboeraresou desu!
subtitles.english: Whoa, you're right! I can't function every morning without coffee, so I'll remember "maiasa" and "breakfast" instantly!

subtitles.speaker: Sensei
subtitles.japanese: いいですね！コーヒーパワーで次の漢字へ行きましょう。
subtitles.romaji: Ii desu ne! Koohii pawaa de tsugi no kanji e ikimashou.
subtitles.english: Love it! Let's ride that coffee power straight to the next Kanji.

subtitles.speaker: Sensei
subtitles.japanese: 二つ目、ボードを見てください！「駅」、Train Stationです。昔は馬が止まる場所だったので、左に馬があります。
subtitles.romaji: Futatsume, boodo o mite kudasai! "Eki", Train Station desu. Mukashi wa uma ga tomaru basho datta node, hidari ni uma ga arimasu.
subtitles.english: Look at the board for number two! "Eki" means Train Station — it has a horse on the left from old relay stations.

subtitles.speaker: Maria
subtitles.japanese: なるほど！私、東京駅でいつも迷子になるんですけど、これからは「駅」を見たら馬を思い出します！
subtitles.romaji: Naruhodo! Watashi, Toukyou-eki de itsumo maigo ni naru n desu kedo, kore kara wa "eki" o mitara uma o omoidashimasu!
subtitles.english: Aha! I always get lost at Tokyo Station, but from now on whenever I see "eki" on the board I'll picture a horse!

subtitles.speaker: Sensei
subtitles.japanese: 三つ目はこちら！「勉」、Effortです。日本語の勉強も、毎日コツコツ力を出すイメージですね。
subtitles.romaji: Mittsume wa kochira! "Ben", Effort desu. Nihongo no benkyou mo, mainichi kotsukotsu chikara o dasu imeeji desu ne.
subtitles.english: Number three right here! "Ben" means Effort — putting steady daily power into your Japanese study.

subtitles.speaker: Maria
subtitles.japanese: 毎日十分でも続けたら、私も漢字マスターになれますかね？
subtitles.romaji: Mainichi juppun demo tsuzuketara, watashi mo kanji masutaa ni naremasu ka ne?
subtitles.english: If I keep it up for even ten minutes a day, can I become a Kanji master too?

subtitles.speaker: Sensei
subtitles.japanese: もちろんです！継続は力なり、バッチリなれますよ！
subtitles.romaji: Mochiron desu! Keizoku wa chikara nari, bacchiri naremasu yo!
subtitles.english: Of course! Consistency is power — you'll totally nail it!

subtitles.speaker: Sensei
subtitles.japanese: 四つ目の漢字を見てください！「料」、IngredientsやFeeです。日本料理や、みんな大好きな「無料」にも使います。
subtitles.romaji: Yottsume no kanji o mite kudasai! "Ryou", Ingredients ya Fee desu. Nihon-ryouri ya, minna daisuki na "muryou" ni mo tsukaimasu.
subtitles.english: Look at Kanji number four! "Ryou" means Ingredients or Fee — used in Japanese cuisine and everyone's favorite word, "free"!

subtitles.speaker: Maria
subtitles.japanese: わあ、「無料」！おかわり無料のお店を見つけたら、テンション最高になりますね！
subtitles.romaji: Waa, "muryou"! Okawari muryou no omise o mitsuketara, tenshon saikou ni narimasu ne!
subtitles.english: Ooh, "muryou" (free)! Finding a restaurant with free refills instantly makes my whole day!

subtitles.speaker: Sensei
subtitles.japanese: 素晴らしいリアクションですね！まさに日本のリアルな表現です。
subtitles.romaji: Subarashii riakushon desu ne! Masa ni Nihon no riaru na hyougen desu.
subtitles.english: Awesome reaction! That's truly real everyday Japanese.

subtitles.speaker: Sensei
subtitles.japanese: 最後は五つ目、ボードを見てください！「話」、SpeakやStoryです。会話や電話で毎日使いますよ。
subtitles.romaji: Saigo wa itsutsume, boodo o mite kudasai! "Hanasu", Speak ya Story desu. Kaiwa ya denwa de mainichi tsukaimasu yo.
subtitles.english: Fifth and final Kanji on the board! "Hanasu" means Speak or Story — used daily in conversation and phone calls.

subtitles.speaker: Maria
subtitles.japanese: 先生とこうして楽しく会話できるのが、私の一番の楽しみです！
subtitles.romaji: Sensei to koushite tanoshiku kaiwa dekiru no ga, watashi no ichiban no tanoshimi desu!
subtitles.english: Having fun conversations with you like this, Sensei, is my favorite part of the day!

subtitles.speaker: Sensei
subtitles.japanese: さあ、お楽しみクイズです！「駅」の意味はどれでしょう？東京で迷子になる前に、考えてみてくださいね！
subtitles.romaji: Saa, otanoshimi kuizu desu! "Eki" no imi wa dore deshou? Toukyou de maigo ni naru mae ni, kangaete mite kudasai ne!
subtitles.english: Now for our fun quiz! What does the Kanji "eki" mean? Think carefully before getting lost in Tokyo!

subtitles.speaker: Sensei
subtitles.japanese: 正解はBのTrain Station、駅でした！よくできましたね！また次のエピソードで会いましょう。
subtitles.romaji: Seikai wa B no Train Station, eki deshita! Yoku dekimashita ne! Mata tsugi no episoodo de aimashou.
subtitles.english: The correct answer is B, Train Station! Well done! See you in the next episode.
